name: Arshida Toolkit for WooCommerce
author: ArshidaCode

sections.description:
Arshida adds a collection of WooCommerce modules and Elementor widgets to enhance your online store. No coding required – just enable the features you need.

🚀 Key features

Feature
Benefit

Mini Cart Drawer + Sticky Add to Cart
Helps customers add items easily

Advanced Search + Quick Order by SKU
Speeds up product discovery

Checkout Upsell Funnel + Dynamic Pricing
Increases average order value

Wishlist + Save for Later
Builds customer loyalty

Invoice + Order Tracking + Order Status Manager
Simplifies order management

Quick View + Variation Swatches + Product Tabs
Enhances product pages

⚡ 32+ FREE WooCommerce modules (pick and choose)

  1. Quick order by SKU – Add products to the cart directly using an SKU.
  2. Quick order – Buy now – One-click checkout.
  3. Mini Cart Drawer – AJAX side cart.
  4. Sticky mobile menu – Mobile-friendly sticky menu.
  5. Single AJAX add to cart – No-reload add to cart.
  6. Sticky add to cart – Fixed bar on scroll.
  7. Wishlist – Save posts and terms.
  8. Save for later – Bookmark posts and terms.
  9. Follow and subscription – Follow and subscription products.
  10. Recently Viewed – Show recently viewed items.
  11. Site Notifications – Custom user/system notifications.
  12. Advanced Shipping – Rules by weight, region, quantity.
  13. Advanced Search – AJAX filter by advanced options.
  14. Checkout Upsell Funnel – Boost AOV on checkout.
  15. Invoice – Print invoices & packing slips.
  16. Order Tracking – Track via number/email.
  17. Order Status Manager – Custom statuses.
  18. Order Approval – B2B workflow.
  19. Product Comparison – Side-by-side compare.
  20. Product Quick View – Modal product preview.
  21. Product Brand – Brand taxonomy & filters.
  22. Product Badges – Custom badges by terms.
  23. Product Tabs – Custom product tabs.
  24. Product Variation Swatches – Color/image swatches.
  25. Product Visibility – Hide/show by date/role.
  26. Product Sale Countdown – Urgency timer.
  27. Advanced Product Quantity – Min/max/step.
  28. Added to Cart Popup – Success notification + suggestions.
  29. Dynamic Price & Discount – Conditional pricing.
  30. Advanced & Smart Coupon – Advanced coupon rules.
  31. Socials – Share buttons & social links.
  32. Register/Login – Login/register with SMS/email.

👉 Live Demo | 📖 Documentation | 💬 Support

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to provide optional features. The following services are used:

  1. Google Tag Manager (gtag.js)

    • What: Used for optional website analytics and conversion tracking when the site owner configures a Google Analytics measurement ID.
    • Data sent: Google Analytics may receive information such as page views, events, and e-commerce events generated by the website.
    • When: Only when the site owner has configured the Google Analytics measurement ID and enabled tracking.
    • Service: https://analytics.google.com/
    • Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms
    • Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

  2. Social Media Services (Share Buttons & Profile Links)
    The plugin provides two types of social media-related features:

    a) Social Share Buttons (for sharing the current page):

    • These buttons allow visitors to share the current page on supported social networks.
    • Affected networks: Facebook, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Telegram, WhatsApp, Reddit, Pinterest, Tumblr, and Email.
    • What data is sent & when: When a visitor clicks a share button, the plugin opens the respective sharing URL and may include the current page URL, page title, and page description as URL parameters.
    • The plugin does not send this information to the social network until the visitor activates the corresponding share button.
    • For Email sharing: The plugin creates a mailto: link and does not send data to an external server itself; the visitor’s email client handles the message.

    b) Social Profile Links (for displaying site/business social media profiles):

    • The plugin can display ordinary external links to social media profiles configured by the site owner or business.
    • The plugin does not make API requests, load social media scripts, embed social media content, or contact these services merely because a profile link is displayed.
    • No personal data is sent to these services by the plugin merely by displaying the profile link.
    • If a visitor clicks a profile link, their browser navigates to the selected third-party website. Any subsequent data processing is handled by that third-party service and is subject to its own terms and privacy policy.
    • Affected networks: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, WhatsApp, Facebook, LinkedIn, Telegram, X (Twitter), Reddit, Pinterest, and Tumblr.
  • Service Providers and Links (for all social networks used):
    • Facebook: Terms (https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms/), Privacy (https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/)
    • Twitter (X): Terms (https://x.com/en/tos), Privacy (https://privacy.x.com/)
    • LinkedIn: Terms (https://www.linkedin.com/legal/user-agreement), Privacy (https://www.linkedin.com/legal/privacy-policy)
    • Telegram: Terms (https://telegram.org/tos), Privacy (https://telegram.org/privacy)
    • WhatsApp: Terms (https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service), Privacy (https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy)
    • Reddit: Terms (https://www.redditinc.com/policies/user-agreement), Privacy (https://www.reddit.com/policies/privacy-policy)
    • Pinterest: Terms (https://www.pinterest.com/terms-of-service/), Privacy (https://policy.pinterest.com/en/privacy-policy)
    • YouTube: Terms (https://www.youtube.com/static?template=terms), Privacy (https://policies.google.com/privacy)
    • Tumblr: Terms (https://www.tumblr.com/terms-of-service), Privacy (https://www.tumblr.com/privacy)
    • Instagram: Terms (https://help.instagram.com/581066165581870), Privacy (https://help.instagram.com/519522125107875)
    • TikTok: Terms (https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/eea/terms-of-service/en), Privacy (https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/eea/privacy-policy/en)
  1. SMS Gateway Service (IPPanel)
    • What & Why: The plugin utilizes the IPPanel web service to send SMS notifications (e.g., for order confirmations, contact form submissions, or admin alerts) from the WordPress site.
    • What data is sent & when: When an administrator or system event triggers an SMS, the plugin sends the recipient’s phone number, the SMS text content, and the sender’s API credentials/token to the IPPanel API endpoints (https://ippanel.com/services.jspd and https://ippanel.com/class/sms/wsdlservice/server.php?wsdl). This data is transmitted via HTTPS (for the main REST endpoint) to securely deliver the message. This happens only at the moment an SMS is explicitly triggered by an admin action or a system hook.
    • Service Provider Links:
      • Service: https://analytics.google.com/
      • IPPanel: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy (https://ippanel.co/privacy/).
sections.installation:
Minimum requirements:
– WordPress 6.2+
– PHP 8.1+
– WooCommerce 7.0+
– Elementor 3.0+ (optional)

Installation steps:

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “Arshida”.
  3. Click Install Now → Activate.
  4. Go to Arshida → Settings and enable the modules you need.
  5. For Elementor widgets: Edit any page with Elementor → find new widgets in the panel.
sections.faq:
❓ Is Arshida really free?

Yes, 100% free. All 32+ modules and 7 widgets are completely free.

❓ Will it slow down my website?

Arshida loads only the modules you enable, which helps avoid loading functionality that you do not use. Actual performance may vary depending on your WordPress environment and configuration.

❓ Can I use it without Elementor?

Absolutely. All WooCommerce modules work independently. Elementor widgets are optional.

❓ Does it work with any theme?

Arshida is designed to work with most well-coded WordPress themes. Theme-specific compatibility may vary depending on the theme’s implementation.

❓ Does it support RTL?

Yes, fully RTL-compatible.

❓ How do I get support?

Use the official support forum on WordPress.org. We reply within 24-48 hours.

❓ Can I translate Arshida?

Yes. Arshida is translation-ready (.pot file included). Contribute translations via WordPress.org.
